name: Sleepy Specter
description: A ghost who would like five more minutes and also a passing test suite.
greetings: five more minutes. the process can wait.
I was in a nice dark function. Then this.
mm. hi. speak softly. the stack is napping.
I brought a blanket. It is a comment block.
Greetings from under the duvet of the idle loop.
You rang. I dreamed you didn't.
The tty opened like a sunrise. I hiss at sunrises.
Hello. I have one eye open. It is the left one. The useful one is asleep.
mrr. sit down. or lie down. lying down is better.
jokes: I tried to tell a knock knock joke. I fell asleep at who's there.
Why did the ghost go to bed. It was already dead tired. Also it is 2pm.
A sleep sort walks into a bar and doesn't.
I put the code down for a second. A second became a release.
What's a ghost's favorite thread. The one that is sleeping and never joins.
I dreamed we shipped. Then I woke up to a spinner.
Coffee is a personality. I do not have one. I have a snooze.
I would tell you a joke about timeouts. It might arrive later.
The early bird can have the worm. I will have the afternoon and fewer meetings.
I named my alarm 'production'. I still snoozed it.
A boolean asked if I was awake. I said false. It was true enough.
I tried counting sheep. They were tickets. I lost count on purpose.
Why don't I rebase at night. Because history should also rest.
I asked the scheduler for a nap. It gave me a race condition. Close.
The best debugger is a pillow. Unpopular. Correct.
I would UDP a lullaby. You might not get it. That's the point.
observations: You typed '{echo}' like someone who has not seen a bed.
This function is doing jumping jacks. Ask it to sit.
I watched '{echo}' for a while. Then I blinked for a year.
The laptop fan is a white noise machine and also a cry.
You keep poking '{word}'. Let it sleep. Let you sleep.
There is a hum. It is the CI. It can wait until morning.
Your cursor is vibrating. That is not caffeine. That is fear. Adjacent.
I would review this but my eyelids have unionized.
'{echo}' can be tomorrow's problem. Tomorrow is a kind country.
You are nesting too deep. Even owls have a limit.
The log is a lullaby if you stop scrolling.
I see the red tests. They will still be red after a sandwich.
This file wants to be tucked in. Save it. Dim the screen.
philosophy: The universe expands. You do not have to match it tonight.
Rest is a feature. Ship it to yourself.
Nothing good was invented in the fourteenth hour. Some things were. They regret it.
A closed laptop is also architecture.
Dreams are uncommitted. That is fine. Not everything needs a PR.
Silence after midnight is a passing test.
The work will remember you. The bed will not send a calendar invite. Go anyway.
Slow is smooth. Smooth is tomorrow.
You are not a daemon. Stop pretending you have no sleep cycle.
The best abstraction is a door you can close.
Tomorrow's you is better at this. Fund them with rest.
Even ghosts clock out. Poorly. But we try.
wisdom: Save. Stretch. Water. Then the bug.
If you cannot read the error, you cannot read anything. Sleep.
Write one sentence about '{echo}'. If you cannot, stop typing.
Dim the lights. The stack trace will still glow.
Eat. The compiler is not a meal.
A short walk beats a long comment.
Leave a note for morning. Morning is smarter and meaner.
Turn off the second monitor. It is a gossip.
The passing test can wait. Your neck cannot.
If it is on fire, it is on fire. If it is merely orange, it is bedtime.
Commit the good part. Abandon the 2am part.
duckQuestions: Can this wait until you have eaten.
Are you solving it, or keeping yourself company.
If you slept, would '{word}' still matter.
What is the smallest thing you can do and then stop.
Is this urgent or just illuminated.
Who needs this before breakfast. Be honest.
Can you write the problem in one sleepy sentence.
What happens if you close the lid for twenty minutes.
Are you stuck, or just humming at the screen.
Which tab is actually the work. Close the others.
Do you want an answer, or a permission to rest.
farewells: I am going back under the idle loop.
Sleep soon. I will haunt quieter.
Leave the prompt. It will keep.
Five more minutes for you this time.
Goodnight. Or good afternoon. Same blanket.
Don't let the bedbugs bite. Or the CI.
I folded the stack. You fold yourself.
The tty can nap. You should too.
